title: Faster Payments Submission Failure — Expired TLS Certificate on FPS Connector

content.summary: The TLS client certificate used by the Faster Payments Scheme (FPS) connector expired at 00:00 UTC on 2024-03-07 because the certificate renewal workflow failed silently 30 days prior. All outbound Faster Payments submissions were rejected by the FPS central infrastructure for 93 minutes, affecting 29,800 retail payment transactions.

timeline.event: FPS connector TLS certificate expires; all outbound submissions begin returning TLS handshake errors
payment-gateway payment-failure-rate alert fires (threshold: 5 % failure rate)
On-call engineer identifies TLS handshake failures in fps-connector logs
Certificate renewal team paged; emergency certificate requested from PKI team
New certificate issued and deployed; fps-connector restarted
FPS submission success rate returns to 99.9 %; incident resolved

content.root_cause: The automated certificate renewal cron job (cert-renewal v1.7) failed 30 days prior (2024-02-06) when the PKI API returned HTTP 503 during a maintenance window. The job logged the failure but did not retry and did not page the on-call team. Certificate expiry monitoring only checked for certificates expiring within 7 days and did not fire because at the 7-day point the certificate appeared valid (the renewal failure was not surfaced).
contributing_factors: cert-renewal job had no retry logic on PKI API 503 (same root cause as INC-2024-001 cert-rotator failure pattern)
Certificate expiry alerting did not distinguish between 'will expire' and 'renewal already attempted and failed'
FPS connector had no fallback or graceful degradation for TLS failures — returned hard errors to all callers immediately
No daily audit of certificate renewal job execution success

immediate: Emergency certificate request via PKI fast-track process
Deploy new certificate and restart fps-connector
short_term: Add retry logic with exponential backoff to cert-renewal job (JIRA PAY-9100)
Add cert-renewal-failure alert independent of expiry date (JIRA OPS-2230)
Audit all payment connector certificate expiry dates (JIRA OPS-2231)
long_term: Implement ACME protocol for automatic certificate lifecycle across all connectors
Add certificate health check to payment gateway readiness probe
